name: B10-0085/2025 (PPE) – Systematic repression of human rights in Iran, notably the cases of Pakhshan Azizi and Wrisha Moradi, and the taking of EU citizens as hostages
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the systematic repression of human rights in Iran, notably the cases of Pakhshan Azizi and Wrisha Moradi, and the taking of EU citizens as hostages
part_text:
The European Parliament calls for Iran to release two women sentenced to death, Pakhshan Azizi and Wrisha Moradi, and to free all European citizens held in Iran. It strongly criticises Iran's human rights record, including treatment of women, religious minorities and Christians. It asks Iran to stop using the death penalty and to scrap laws that discriminate against activists. It also asks European Union countries to treat Iran's Revolutionary Guard as a terrorist group and to add more Iranian officials to sanctions lists.

- **What changes:** Nothing yet. The Parliament is stating demands and opinions, not passing law.
- **Who it affects:** Iran's government, detained European and dual citizens, and two women on death row.
- **What happens next:** The resolution is sent to European Union bodies and Iranian authorities; no action is binding.
